items.docs: Returns a paginated list of all payment links created by your application.

Creates a payment link that can be shared with customers to collect payments. 
The link remains ACTIVE until it expires, reaches its usage limit, or is explicitly disabled.

items.docs: Retrieves the current state of a payment link, including its status, usage count, and configuration.

params.name: payment_link_id

items.docs:
Changes the status of a payment link. 
Set status to `DISABLED` to immediately stop the link from accepting new payments, or `ACTIVE` to re-enable a previously disabled link. 
Links in `EXPIRED` or `USED` status cannot be reactivated.

params.name: usage_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the payment link usage.

items.docs:
Returns the details of a single payment link usage, including its current status,
the identifiers collected from the payer during the payment flow, and the resulting
payment reference once the bank has processed the payment.

The `payment_id` and `payment_status` fields are populated asynchronously - they will
be `null` immediately after usage creation and will be set once the payment has
been processed by the bank.
